title: The Scm FCS finger binds the Pcl Tudor domain to link canonical PRC1 and PRC2.1 in Drosophila.
authors: Yesil, Berfin; Steigenberger, Barbara; Bonnet, Jacques; Muller, Jurg
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文通过AlphaFold3建模和实验验证揭示果蝇PRC1与PRC2.1复合物间Scm-Pcl的直接蛋白-蛋白互作，虽非TF-DNA体系，但涉及蛋白复合物界面建模与互作机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Canonical Polycomb Repressive Complex 1 (PRC1) was previously reported to selectively associate with Polycomb Repressive Complex 2.1 (PRC2.1) in cross-linking-based affinity purification experiments from Drosophila embryos, but the molecular basis of this interaction has remained unresolved. Here, we established an affinity-purification strategy using cryo-milled Drosophila embryos that recovers intact canonical PRC1 together with the complete PRC2.1 complex without chemical cross-linking. Using AlphaFold3 to systematically model interactions between canonical PRC1 and PRC2.1 subunits, we identified a single high-confidence interface between the FCS finger of the canonical PRC1 accessory subunit Sex comb on midleg (Scm) and the atypical Tudor domain of the PRC2.1 accessory subunit Polycomblike (Pcl). Recombinant Scm FCS finger and Pcl Tudor domain formed a stable complex in vitro, as demonstrated by size-exclusion chromatography and native mass spectrometry. Structure-guided mutagenesis validated the predicted interface: point mutations in either interaction partner abolished complex formation, whereas complementary charge-reversal mutations restored binding. These findings identify the Scm-Pcl interaction as the molecular basis for the selective association between canonical PRC1 and PRC2.1 in Drosophila and reveal that communication between these complexes is mediated by a direct interaction between these accessory subunits.
abstract_zh: 经典Polycomb抑制复合物1（canonical PRC1）此前在果蝇胚胎的基于交联的亲和纯化实验中被报道选择性地与Polycomb抑制复合物2.1（PRC2.1）结合，但这一相互作用的分子基础仍未明确。在此，我们建立了一种使用冷冻研磨果蝇胚胎的亲和纯化策略，该策略无需化学交联即可回收完整的经典PRC1及完整的PRC2.1复合物。利用AlphaFold3系统性地建模经典PRC1与PRC2.1亚基之间的相互作用，我们识别出经典PRC1辅助亚基Sex comb on midleg（Scm）的FCS指状结构域与PRC2.1辅助亚基Polycomblike（Pcl）的非典型Tudor结构域之间的单一高置信度界面。重组Scm FCS指状结构域和Pcl Tudor结构域在体外形成稳定复合物，这通过尺寸排阻色谱和天然质谱得到证实。结构引导的突变验证了预测的界面：任一相互作用伙伴中的点突变均消除了复合物形成，而互补的电荷反转突变则恢复了结合。这些发现将Scm-Pcl相互作用确定为果蝇中经典PRC1与PRC2.1选择性关联的分子基础，并揭示这些复合物之间的通讯是由这些辅助亚基之间的直接相互作用介导的。
